title: AI systems and the reproduction of (standard) language ideologies in World Englishes

bias_targets.methodology: Synthesis of empirical evaluation studies on model performance across dialects (e.g., AAVE), targeted prompting experiments (e.g., generating text in Nigerian English), and corpus-based frequency analysis to compare lexical usage (e.g., the word 'delve') across regional English varieties.

Critical discourse analysis of social media debates, news articles, and public commentary to evaluate ideological prejudices and center-periphery hierarchies against Global South populations and their linguistic norms.
